caption: The drawing depicts a single, crescent-shaped object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object resembles a decorative textile or lace collar, outlined with intricate, symmetrical patterns consisting of loops, floral motifs, and small oval shapes. The collar is rendered in fine, dark lines, creating contrast with the lighter background. There are several rows of detailed holes, swirls, and repeating geometric and organic designs throughout the surface of the collar. The collar widens towards the edges and tapers slightly at the ends. There is a small, rectangular label with the word “COTON” in black near the bottom right of the collar. No other objects or background elements are present.
title: Embroidered Linen Collar
